verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Jev is a metered model API, but nothing in the evidence documents prompt or prefix caching or a cached-token price. The pricing page lists only a flat per-input-token rate. The cookbook's cost savings come from batching many questions into one call over shared state, which is a different feature, not caching of repeated context across requests.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can cut cost and latency on repeated context with documented prompt/prefix caching and its pricing
